description: An open-source, local-first AI teammate and agent operating environment for turning intent into completed work—with tools, memory, permissions, and human oversight.
summary: The token-efficient agentic coding workbench. Built for a future where every token counts — it optimizes token usage at the agent-loop level, saving 70%+ on long sessions, while planning, remembering your codebase, and shipping features in parallel from a single self-hosted binary.
